reviews.text: Thanks for the help today with new puppy Jeffrey. The chews we got for teething have done the trick. You literally may have saved my fingers! 🤞🤌🤌 …

Amazing shop with a very carefully curated collection. They helped us with picking the right products for our wee dog (also took the best photo of him with his new Hush Muff). Ziggy definitely approves the treats he got 💛 …
Fantastic pet shop with eco friendly dog toys and treats and great friendly staff
Great selection of dog treats and toys. Woman who served us was super nice to us and great with our dog. Short walk from Queen’s Park & Queens Park recreation ground
Fabulous little shop with tons of incredible food, treats, toys and everything else you’d need for your precious furry companions. Great customer service also. Would highly recommend.
Lovely shop. Easily labeled and easy to browse and cant go wrong with natural treats for the babies.
Great shop, was at vet across road and popped in with my puppy. Person was so helpful at advice on treats and chews and it’s a lovely shop. Will definitely be back.
The best dog shop in Glasgow!
Awesome shop. Great selection and really helpful, I'd highly recommend it over any supermarket branded stuff, they really care and everything they sell is super high quality.
We absolutely love odd dogs and so does our wee dog Peggy Sue - the staff are so knowledgeable and clearly love dogs.

A dog walker! Odd Dogs is full of cracking dog toys, great dog food and great dogware. My new go to! I love it.

Great wee shop, there's lot's of 'stuff'. If I sound like a novice dog owner, well, that's because I am. I always ask the owner(?) all the dumb questions, I'm grateful for her patience with me. Nice local business.
